prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a blooming lavender field in neat rows under a clear sky with a gravel path, a wooden gate and fence of normal height, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Brazilian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-bronzed glowing skin, gold and copper shimmer eyes, a glossy nude-coral lip, vivid copper-orange hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large silver hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a tin small flared temple bell, a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a tin barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold barrel-shaped weight, a tin small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered platinum necklaces. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal deep purple satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, paired with a micro strapless deep purple satin bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, leaving the curve of her bust visible above and below it, her stomach fully visible below it.
LEFT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme gold ballet heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Maori man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, light smoky eyeliner and glossy skin, smooth warm olive-brown skin, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a bronze chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten platinum rings. Extremely long stiletto nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing nothing but the smallest possible white leather micro pouch cut tight to the body on two thin side strings tied high at the hips and a thin strap at the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his skin otherwise fully bare.
RIGHT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme gold needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
